verdict.rationale: Alma is a tech-enabled immigration law firm with a client portal and company program dashboard, so API parity is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence shows only UI-driven workflows such as online questionnaires and scheduling meetings. Probes for OpenAPI or Swagger specs all returned 404, and no public API is documented anywhere in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
